title: Why Web3 gaming is quietly making a comeback

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know Web3 gaming is making a comeback?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It's not just hype — real players are earning real money.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Web3 gaming lets you own in-game items as NFTs.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Axie Infinity and The Sandbox are leading the charge.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Players now earn over $100 million monthly in-game.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This shift gives power back to gamers, not corporations.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to see how you can play and profit?

caption_text: Why Web3 gaming is quietly making a comeback
